title: Dendrochronology
description: A tree lays down a ring a year, wide in good years and narrow in bad, and every tree in a region keeps the same pattern. Slide a beam's rings along a master chronology until the patterns match, and its outermost ring is dated to the year it was felled. The match is tested by correlation: Baillie and Pilcher's t. Unlocks the Tree-Ring Correlator.

puzzle.goal: A beam's ring widths correlate with the master chronology with coefficient r over n overlapping years. Write Student's t for that correlation.
puzzle.name: The cross-dating t
puzzle.ask: Find t for r = @{r} over n = @{n} years.
puzzle.method: The correlation measured over n pairs is tested against no match at all: t has n − 2 degrees of freedom.
